facts.fact: DGSSI, acting as national trust services authority, approved Damanesign on 3 March 2025 to issue qualified electronic signature and electronic seal certificates, the approval valid two years to 3 March 2027.

MAR.note: Nothing on civil register and ID links.
DGSSI appears only as trust services authority; no response, strategy or designation facts.

facts.fact: The DGSSI decision applies Law No. 43-20 on trust services for electronic transactions, promulgated by dahir of 31 December 2020.
The decision cites Decree No. 2-22-687 of 16 November 2022 as made for the application of Law 43-20.
DGSSI approved Damanesign as a trust service provider under Law 43-20 on 3 March 2025, after a commission ruling of 13 February 2025.
